chain.label: No graphical SLD icing forecast available for Alaska
chain.trigger: pilots will still not be able to access information about potential SLD icing conditions for Alaska because the CIP and FIP website does not depict that information

chain.label: SLD icing outside aircraft icing certification envelope; ice accretes aft of deice boots
chain.trigger: SLD icing conditions are outside the envelopes used for aircraft icing certification (contained in Appendix C of 14 CFR Part 25)

chain.label: Inadvertent encounter with SLD icing conditions at 10,000-10,500 ft
chain.trigger: an in-flight upset resulting from an inadvertent encounter with supercooled large droplet (SLD) icing conditions after takeoff from Fairbanks

caused_by.evidence: the pilot ... stated that she knew about the potential for icing conditions but that she did not expect the airplane to encounter SLD icing

chain.label: Autopilot suddenly disengaged during descent
chain.trigger: During the descent, the autopilot "suddenly" disengaged

caused_by.evidence: the pilot began a gradual descent back to 10,000 ft. During the descent, the autopilot "suddenly" disengaged

chain.label: Aileron controls jammed / ice-induced hinge moment anomaly
chain.trigger: she was "fighting" to regain control of the airplane because the aileron controls were "jammed"

caused_by.evidence: a ridge of ice accreted beyond the airplane's deice boots, causing "a sudden and unexpected aileron hinge moment reversal"
SLD conditions are most conducive to the formation of thin, rough ice on or aft of the protected surfaces

chain.label: Uncommanded right bank and steep nose-down spiraling descent
chain.trigger: the airplane entered an abrupt uncommanded right bank followed by a steep nose-down spiraling descent

caused_by.evidence: the autopilot "suddenly" disengaged, and the airplane entered an abrupt uncommanded right bank
she was "fighting" to regain control of the airplane because the aileron controls were "jammed"

chain.label: Right aileron substantially damaged during the upset
chain.trigger: A postaccident examination of the airplane found that the right aileron sustained substantial damage during the upset

caused_by.evidence: the right aileron sustained substantial damage during the upset

chain.label: Pilot regained control at about 3,100 ft
chain.trigger: FAA automatic dependent surveillance-broadcast data showed that the pilot regained control at an altitude of about 3,100 ft

caused_by.evidence: the pilot regained control at an altitude of about 3,100 ft

chain.label: Emergency declared and emergency landing at Fairbanks
chain.trigger: the pilot declared an in-flight emergency and made an emergency landing at FAI

caused_by.evidence: Afterward, the pilot declared an in-flight emergency and made an emergency landing at FAI
